'''Jerry Heind''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2001 Parker tournament]] on 4 August 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM his way]], according to David Jones's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2802">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-07-parker-colorado-8-4-01d2802/ parker-colorado-8-4-01], DeckTech (David "DavCJ" Jones, 7 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-07-parker-colorado-8-4-01d2802/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
